Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DMIS_TO_LAB
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure dmis_to_lab is
 t_drive_id varchar2(15);
 interf_id varchar2(10);
 ctr number(2) := 0;
begin
 go_block('drives');
 first_record;
 loop 
 t_drive_id := :drives.drive_id;
 ctr := ctr + 1; 
 :current_unit_no := :system.cursor_record;
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;

 DON_LAB_DRV.interface_drives(t_drive_id, null, null,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id, interf_id );

 IF ctr = 50 THEN 
 :system.message_level := 5; 
 post;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 ctr := 0;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_DRIVES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE fetch_drives IS
 cursor c1 is
 select drive_id, drive_date from drives 
 where trunc(drive_date) between :ctrl_blk_1.from_date 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.to_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and rownum < 10000
 order by drive_date, drive_id;
BEGIN
 set_item_property('drives.drive_id', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_block('drives');
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;
 first_record;

 for i in c1
 loop
 :drives.drive_id := i.drive_id; 
 :drives.drive_date := i.drive_date;
 next_record; 
 end loop;
 IF :system.cursor_record != 1 THEN
 clear_record;
 END IF;
 first_record;
 IF :drives.drive_id is null THEN
 clear_message;
 clear_block;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.from_date');
 show_error('2105');
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.date_unit_flg = 'D' THEN
 set_item_property('drives.drive_id', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 go_item('DRIVES.DRIVE_DATE');
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.date_unit_flg = 'V' THEN
 set_item_property('drives.drive_id', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 go_item('DRIVES.DRIVE_ID');
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.date_unit_flg = 'A' THEN
 set_item_property('drives.drive_id', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 go_item('DRIVES.DRIVE_DATE');
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 clear_message;
Exception when OTHERS THEN
 clear_message;
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FETCH_ALL_RECORDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE fetch_all_records IS
 no_of_days number(4);
 chp_sysdate date:=Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:Global.chapter_id,SYSDATE);
 cursor c1 is
 select drive_id, drive_date from drives 
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and drive_date between trunc(chp_sysdate) and trunc(chp_sysdate) + no_of_days
 order by drive_date, drive_id;
BEGIN
 set_item_property('drives.drive_id', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 BEGIN
 SELECT parameter_value INTO no_of_days
 FROM valid_parameters 
 WHERE parameter_code = 'DNLB_DRIVE'
 AND parameter_type = 'ALL'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+10);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 chp_sysdate:=Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:Global.chapter_id,SYSDATE);
 
 go_block('drives');
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;
 first_record;
 for i in c1
 loop
 :drives.drive_id := i.drive_id; 
 :drives.drive_date := i.drive_date;
 next_record; 
 end loop;
 IF :system.cursor_record != 1 THEN
 clear_record;
 END IF;
 first_record;
 IF :drives.drive_id is null THEN
 clear_message;
 clear_block;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.date_unit_flg');
 show_error('2105');
 ELSE
 last_record;
 END IF;
 clear_message;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 IF :system.cursor_block = 'DRIVES' and :drives.drive_id is null THEN
 clear_record;
 END IF;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure; 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.date_unit_flg = 'D' THEN 
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.from_date');
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.to_date');
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 fetch_drives;
 ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.date_unit_flg = 'A' THEN
 fetch_all_records;
 END IF;
 go_block('drives');
 last_record;
 :last_unit_no := nvl(:system.trigger_record,0);
 go_record('1');
 ---
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk_1.start_dats := v_local_time; -- IM#5323
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.start_dats := sysdate;
 end if; 
 ---
 --:start_dats := sysdate;
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 synchronize;
 dmis_to_lab;
 check_package_failure;
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 :ctrl_blk_1.end_dats := v_local_time;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.end_dats := sysdate;
 end if;
 --:end_dats := sysdate;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 message('Interface completed ....');
 pause;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
exception
 when others then
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 message('Interface failed with error '|| sqlerrm); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;
